envelope.description: Gate the define extend path before its first write

body.title: Gate the define extend path before its first write
body.summary: In finalizeDefineExtend (src/workflow/orchestrator.ts), after the Epic anchor is resolved and before appendStoryToDefine, call assertMayReviseDraft for the unit {epic, repoPath, epicHash}, stage DEF and authoring 'define'. A refusal throws before the Story, the amendment or the EXT record is written; every existing validation failure still returns first, so the gate does not run for a request that fails anyway. The first define of a fresh Epic is not gated. The test drives the existing define-extend test harness (the orchestrator entry the existing extend tests use) with a stand-in policy reader and tracker port through the gate's test seams; no new export is added unless that harness cannot reach the function.
acceptanceChecks: an extend by someone who is not the holder, while the Define is in signoff, is refused and writes no Story, no amendment and no EXT record
the holder's extend, and an extend in a repo with no team policy, are written as today
a duplicate Story id or an unapproved Epic still fails before the gate is asked
a ToolDenied from the gate stops the run and is not turned into a refusal

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/define-extend-gate.test.ts: the define extend path refuses a non-holder while the Define is in signoff and writes nothing, and the holder's extend is written as today
src/workflow/__tests__/define-extend-gate.test.ts: a repo with no team policy makes no tracker call and the extend is written as today
src/workflow/__tests__/define-extend-gate.test.ts: a duplicate Story id or an unapproved Epic fails before the gate is asked, and a denied tracker call in the gate stops the run
